To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

consciousness is the set of all the brain processes that are the causes of behaviour and the effects of behaviour, and that the brain processes that cause consciousness are the same as the brain processes that realize consciousness.
consciousness is a biological process, it is realized in the physical structure of the brain, it is a causal process, and it has an evolutionary function.

(i) consciousness is the information processing in the brain that gives rise to sensory qualia, (ii) the brain processes that cause consciousness can be studied scientifically, (iii) the brain processes are those that give rise to the brain's global workspace, (iv) consciousness has an evolutionary function, and (v) consciousness can be reduced to a physical process without dualism.
